steps.output:
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    if w > h:
        sep = next(c for c in range(w) if all(row[c] == row[0] for row in grid) and len({row[c] for row in grid}) == 1)
        left = [row[:sep] for row in grid]
        right = [row[sep+1:] for row in grid]
        shared = next(x for x in {v for row in left for v in row} if x in {v for row in right for v in row})
        return [[3 if x == shared and y == shared else shared for x, y in zip(a,b)] for a,b in zip(left,right)]
    sep = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and all(row[0] not in other for j, other in enumerate(grid) if j != i))
    top, bottom = grid[:sep], grid[sep+1:]
    shared = next(x for x in {v for row in top for v in row} if x in {v for row in bottom for v in row})
    return [[3 if x == shared and y == shared else shared for x, y in zip(a,b)] for a,b in zip(top,bottom)]
